# Studio Page: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

A Studio browser with a dedicated detail page and large Draw viewer.

Reader: People working within a Block, Job or Task

## Procedure

### 1. Find

Browse one Studio per row.

### 2. Explore

Open the Draw and the product it proposes.

### 3. Review

Read its delivery contract and open questions.

### 4. Continue

Open the source Studio in the workbench.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Every row identifies its Studio and intended delivery.
- [ ] Draw and delivery open from the same row.
- [ ] The detail page keeps the reader oriented.
- [ ] Narrow screens retain readable actions.

## Open design choice

Should a Studio detail open on its Draw or its delivery preview?
